name: Asphyxiating Taxidermy (CR 13)
body:
Asphyxiating Taxidermy
CR 13

XP 25,600
CE persistent haunt
Caster Level 13th
Notice Perception DC 25 (to see gasping mounted heads)
hp 58; Trigger proximity; Reset 1 day

EFFECT

When triggered, dozens of moldering taxidermic heads gasp for breath in dead-eyed concert, sucking the air from the room and drawing the breath from living creatures. All creatures within the hallway are subject to a mass suffocation spell (save DC 23).

DESTRUCTION

Destroying or immolating all of the taxidermic heads destroys the possessing haunt forever.
